q0AnchorReason: Evaluates at the PROTON pin. q0 enters through q_parameter.Q_50_DIGIT_STR, which resolves to the proton anchor (1.1099785827513808075...) because this stem is not listed under ideal_muon; proton is the standing default for compute per the 2026-08-07 owner directive. The stem IS declared physical_proton in computations/q0_anchor_manifest.json, and that declaration cannot stamp this witness: the manifest is read inside WitnessBuilder.build(), and this producer hand-rolls its witness and never enters build(). Hence the declaration here, which is the only route that reaches the file.
name: logratio-exactly-extensive
description: The log-ratio channel L = log(S_off/S_on) is exactly linear in the bond count with slope -log f, verified to 1e-30 on both pure chains at A=2..5; and the mechanism is that the free-trace growth g cancels from the ratio.
scope: (b) for the shape (exact linearity, Lean-backed); (a) on magnitude, which is NOT addressed

assertions.name: log-ratio is exactly linear in bonds on both species
assertions.detail: worst relative deviation: pp 2.412e-30, nn 9.151e-31 — exact at compute precision. Lean: QOU.MassTheory.MarginalRatio.logRatio_linear_in_bonds.

assertions.name: the slope reproduces the independently-computed chain bond
assertions.detail: bpp_a_dependence_bound_probe computed -alpha*ln z from the convention-D z directly; this derives the same number as the slope of a measured log-ratio. Two routes, one value.

assertions.name: L is independent of g — recomputing with g scaled 1.7x agrees to <1e-30 (not exactly; see note)
assertions.detail: Lean: QOU.MassTheory.MarginalRatio.logRatio_independent_of_growth. This is the mechanism behind the corpus's assertion that the extensive invariant is the log-ratio, which had been stated without a derivation.

assertions.name: the magnitude gap is stated, attributed, and NOT claimed to be addressed here
assertions.detail: Scope (a) on magnitude. The -63 % figure and the many-body signs are the t7qv arc's measurements (commits c1491ec174, 2bbb6115c5), cited not re-derived.
